retrievalProfile.description: A centered studio portrait of a woman with short dark hair against a deep red radial gradient, featuring neon-style script at the top and bottom.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered shoulder-up portrait of a woman with short, textured dark hair. She has a neutral expression and soft studio lighting. The background is a dramatic red-to-black radial vignette. The composition is framed by thin yellow script text at the top and bottom, with a circular yellow graphic element in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by top and bottom horizontal text
Yellow typography contrasting against deep red background
Circular sticker element balancing the upper right quadrant
Radial light fall-off focusing attention on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, filling the middle 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright red lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top script, down to the eyes, then to the bottom script, with a secondary glance at the circular sticker.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep red vignette corners provide breathing room for the central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for typography and graphic elements
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and saturated red lipstick
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading to low value (black) at the edges.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight resembling neon tubing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters are compact and tightly connected
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for main titles paired with a clean sans-serif for secondary metadata inside the circular sticker.
graphicDevices: Thin red border around the entire frame

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the era's casual but stylized handwriting

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with short wet-look dark hair, centered, against a deep red radial vignette background that fades to black at the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add yellow double-line script text at the top and bottom center. Place a yellow circular sticker with small black sans-serif text in the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a red radial gradient?
Is the text yellow and script-based?
Is the subject centered and shoulder-up?
Is there a circular graphic in the top right?

postGenerationChecks: Check for yellow script at top and bottom
Ensure circular sticker is in upper right
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Subject: Woman, Hair: Short/Wet) + Background(Red Radial Vignette) + Typography(Yellow Script, Top/Bottom) + Graphic(Yellow Circle, Top Right)
